title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Everyday Conversation and Extended Speaking
prompt: In many countries, people are spending less time engaged in face-to-face conversation and more time communicating through short digital messages. Some observers argue that this shift is weakening the ability to sustain extended spoken interaction, such as the two-minute monologue required in language tests or professional presentations. What problems does this trend create for individuals and society, and what solutions can you propose to encourage the development of everyday question-and-answer skills and longer spoken turns? Write at least 250 words. In your essay, you should address both the problems and the solutions, and you should support your ideas with reasons and examples from your own knowledge or experience.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作Task 2练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请针对题目要求，写一篇不少于250词的议论文，明确讨论该趋势带来的问题，并提出解决方案。建议先规划结构：引言引出话题，主体段落分别论述问题与对策，结论总结。注意使用具体例子支持观点，并确保回答完整覆盖题目所有要求。
